## Source: amazon-inspector (119bab3cdb4cabd15ac2188f71ea5f4200b1132281bb67b6b0768b5ccb77871a)
Analysis of codecraze 0.1.0 on PyPI (13 files) surfaced no indicators of supply-chain attack behavior. No install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or environment scraping, no fetch-and-execute of remote payloads, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no persistence mechanisms, and no obfuscated code paths were identified in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (1811daf51a786c7fc7dfea9a979a5f53626825eca9d18b61220b6366617ecb33)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
